lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#13 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Seattle Seahawks −13.0 with a fair total of 45.0, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Arizona Cardinals pass offence vs Seattle Seahawks pass defence, which sits −0.238 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Arizona Cardinals and Seattle Seahawks have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
